rectus_femoris: Mean of recfem_r and recfem_l element forces; not quadriceps sum.
colors: One common absolute linear N scale across muscles and motions; not activation or capacity.
slow_display_interpolation: Linear blending between adjacent 60 Hz source renders; curves use source force times.
jump_height_definition: Prescribed scenario COM rise from takeoff to apex; not jump-and-reach.

tension_exposure.metric: Integral of nonnegative scalar muscle tension over physical time.
tension_exposure.windows: CMJ movement onset to takeoff; squat start of descent to end of ascent. No quiet lead-in or flight.

source_credits: compact footer on force-time standing-pose conclusion card
